notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger
Resolve the Scuzzback Marauders trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
